time_contract.demo_clock_warning: LAB-only illustrative contact occurs at 0.90s after the declared 0.45s cast; it is not a Combat V2 receipt. projectile_speed is 0, so there is no caster-to-target flight, homing, or gameplay projectile. The six-second chest mark is a visual timing exercise based on declared duration, not proof of runtime attachment or expiry.
time_contract.key_pose_budget_note: Five independently generated hand-painted fist/contact/recoil RGBA poses plus one separately generated small mark source. Five hero pose sources are all distinct silhouettes; no old sprite is moved, rotated, resized or recolored to simulate frame changes. Godot uses genuine source-image poses with holds and fades only.

phases.expected_phase: original compact fist at caster hand during canonical cast window
original peak fist follows one moving target chest anchor
painted local contact at moving target with no gameplay hit claim

moving_target.actor_animation: Unchanged approved caster idle and one unchanged V5 WALK monster; the monster follows a deterministic LAB path from 0.20–0.94s. Original fist art appears locally at the moving target after cast; no projectile trajectory is shown.
moving_target.contact_anchor: selected target upper torso at target_feet(t) + (0,-88), local contact at chest+(0,18); small mark at target_feet(t)+(18,-82), never over head/face
moving_target.tracking_rule: Only target index 0 receives the simulated contact and six-second mark. Both follow its current deterministic moving anchor. LAB synthetic timing only; no damage, gameplay event, projectile, or additional hit is generated.

proof_contract.source: Run by .github/workflows/vfx-shared-skill.yml on the exact Draft PR #72 SHA with Godot 4.7.2 stable. True native 1280x720 screenshots at charge, peak and moving-target contact plus source/atlas SHA evidence. Technical output never implies art or owner approval.
